main.$description: interface font — all UI text (nav, cards, lists, body, labels). SIL OFL, free to bundle.

brand.$description: DA brand font (Figma variable marque/famille = "Base Neue Variable") — used ONLY by Titre/Display, Titre/Éditorial and Affiche/Débat, at most one element per screen (SCRUM-449). Base Neue (Power Type Foundry) is licensed for the app (client decision 30 Oct) and bundled as ONE variable file: iOS Theme/Resources/Fonts/BaseNeue-Variable.ttf (PostScript BaseNeueVar-ThinUltraCond), Android core/theme res/font/base_neue_variable.ttf. Commercial licence — no OFL file. The variable file's default instance is Super Condensed Thin (wdth 50, wght 100), so every use must pin BOTH wght and wdth (each style's fontWidth). Base Neue's named weights sit off the CSS scale on its wght axis (Medium = 488.03, Extra Bold = 797.53); the native font binding maps fontWeight to those coordinates. This string is the file's typographic family name (name ID 16).

editorial.$description: DA dark-editorial token — Titre/Éditorial mobile size (Base Neue Condensed Extra Bold 30/30) for founder-principle titles; rendered in typography.fontFamily.brand. Desktop uses 44.

extrabold.$description: DA dark-editorial token — Extra Bold for Titre/Éditorial (founder-principle titles). Figma's Base Neue style is 'Condensed Extra Bold' (wght axis 797.53); 800 is the standard-scale mapping — the native font binding pins the Base Neue axis value.

style.$description: DA type ramp — one entry per Figma text style (verified against the file's local text styles, Republike · Responsive mode Mobile). fontSize / lineHeight in px (pt/sp); letterSpacing in em (Figma % / 100, e.g. -1% = -0.01); fontWeight numeric; fontWidth is the Base Neue width instance — 'normal' (wdth 100), 'condensed' (Condensed, wdth 75) or 'superCondensed' (Super Cond, wdth 50) — and must be pinned explicitly on every brand use (the variable file defaults to wdth 50); textCase 'uppercase' when the Figma style forces upper case. fontFamily is an alias to typography.fontFamily.*.

titreDisplay.$description: Titre/Display — Base Neue Medium (normal width, wdth 100) 40/48 -1% (brand; at most one per screen)

titreEditorial.$description: Titre/Éditorial — Base Neue Condensed Extra Bold (wdth 75) 30/30 (brand; desktop 44)

afficheDebat.$description: Affiche/Débat — Base Neue Condensed Extra Bold (wdth 75) 26/26 UPPERCASE (brand)

rythme.$description: DA layout rhythm (Republike · Responsive, mode Mobile). Desktop values: 64 / 12 / 40 / 64.

ecartTitre.$description: DA rythme/ecart-titre — gap between a title and its content
